deadEnd.details: Every flight search (deep link and homepage form, two fresh proxy sessions on 2026-10-02) lands on an AA-branded 'Please confirm you're a human' / 'I'm not a robot' checkbox page before any fares. detectChallenge() reported detected:false on it.

gotchas: americanairlines.com redirects to aa.com. From a non-US connection add ?locale=en_US (homePage.do?locale=en_US); the From field pre-fills the local airport.
A OneTrust preference-centre overlay (div.onetrust-pc-dark-filter) intercepts clicks on first load; there is no #onetrust-accept-btn-handler, dismiss it with button.save-preference-btn-handler.
Trip type: click label[for="flightSearchForm.tripType.oneWay"] (the radio itself is covered).

The search results page is behind a 'Please confirm you're a human' checkbox CAPTCHA, both from the homepage form and from the /booking/search?locale=en_US&type=OneWay&slices=[...] deep link. It is not flagged by detectChallenge(); check the page heading. Never solve it; hand it to the owner or stop.
Homepage fields resolve by role: role=textbox[name=/^From From/], role=textbox[name=/^To To/], role=textbox[name=/^Depart \(date/] (mm/dd/yyyy).
